Hi Lauren,

Thanks for moving forward with the demo. Our execs have asked that a senior Red-wood sponsor (VP-level) attend, and ideally our CIO will be present as well. We have an internal decision window the week of July 26, so timing is a bit tight.

Can you confirm whether a VP and an engineering exec (VP/Director responsible for platform or CTO-level presence) can join a 45-minute session? We prefer mornings PT: options we have are July 27 9–10am, July 28 8–9am, or July 29 10–11am PT. If none of those work, let us know alternatives.

Thanks — appreciate the help coordinating.
